title: Total breeding bird abundance, US & Canada (billion birds)

source.name: Decline of the North American avifauna
source.publisher: Rosenberg et al., Science (Cornell Lab of Ornithology / American Bird Conservancy)

notes: Landmark 2019 Science study synthesizing 48 years of monitoring data (529 species, 76% of North American breeding birds). Net loss of nearly 3 billion birds, a 29% decline from the 1970 baseline.
